data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly demands an ordering justified by blast radius: 'what corrupts the append-only record vs what merely hides a refusal.' SRC_002 places the scratch-recovery guard fourth in priority but provides no blast-radius justification for that ranking — its mechanism merely asserts 'fourth in priority because the failure mode is a recovery-path failure' without explaining how recovery-path failure compares to append-only-record corruption (the torn-tail repair gate) or refusal-hiding (the lease-mismatch guard). The target's own countercondition concedes that if the recovery guard feeds back into append-only-record integrity it may outrank the lease-mismatch refusal, yet it never resolves whether that causal chain exists. Without that resolution, the ordering is unjustified per the problem's stated standard.
